result.name: core
result.description: Always-on diagnostics and toolset management.

result.name: inspection
result.description: Read-only project, scene, and node inspection.

result.name: scene_edit
result.description: Create, modify, and delete nodes, scripts, signals, and scenes (mutating + destructive).

result.name: runtime
result.description: Run the project headless and capture its output/errors.

result.name: scripts
result.description: Read, write, and patch GDScript files; check for parse errors.

result.name: resources_edit
result.description: Read/create/edit resource (.tres) files and register autoloads.

result.name: project
result.description: Explore the filesystem, search files, read/write project settings, resolve UIDs.

result.name: editor
result.description: Capture editor screenshots (image content for vision-capable clients).

result.name: physics
result.description: Configure physics bodies, collision shapes, layers/masks, and raycasts.

result.name: animation
result.description: Author animations (tracks/keyframes) and AnimationTree state machines/blend trees.

result.name: scene_3d
result.description: Build 3D scenes: mesh instances, cameras, lights, WorldEnvironment, and GridMap cells.

result.name: particles
result.description: Create/configure GPU particle systems: process material, color gradients, and VFX presets.

result.name: navigation
result.description: Author navigation: regions, agents, navmesh baking, and navigation layers.

result.name: audio
result.description: Set up audio: stream players, audio bus layout, and bus effects.

result.name: tilemap
result.description: Edit TileMap/TileMapLayer cells: set, fill rect, get, clear, list layers.

result.name: theme_ui
result.description: Create themes and override colors, font sizes, and styleboxes on Control nodes.

result.name: shader
result.description: Author shaders: create/read shader files, assign ShaderMaterial, set shader parameters.

result.name: input_map
result.description: Edit the project's Input Map actions and events (add/remove/clear).

result.name: input
result.description: Drive a running game: synthesize key/mouse/action input and play input sequences (needs a play session + runtime probe).

result.name: testing
result.description: Automated play-testing: run scenarios, assert live node state, diff screenshots, and fuzz with random input.

result.name: profiling
result.description: Read Godot performance monitors (FPS, draw calls, memory, physics) for the editor or a running game.

result.name: batch
result.description: Operate over many nodes/scenes: find by type, batch-set a property, cross-scene edits, and dependency analysis.

result.name: analysis
result.description: Static project analysis: unused resources, signal flow, circular script dependencies, and scene-complexity stats.

result.name: export
result.description: Drive the export pipeline: list presets, report export info, and run an export (needs export templates).

result.name: debugger
result.description: Debugger breakpoint control: set, remove, clear breakpoints and force breaks in a running game (needs a play session).

result.name: asset_import
result.description: Import external assets (local files or URLs) into the project and assemble PBR materials from textures.

result.name: visual_shader
result.description: Create and edit Visual Shader node graphs: create shaders, add nodes, wire connections, and set node parameters.

result.name: project_scaffold
result.description: Generate a project skeleton (directories, settings, autoloads, root scene) for common game types so agents start from a known structure.

result.name: composite
result.description: Macro tools that collapse multi-step scene edits into one atomic, single-undo round-trip (compose a node with script/children, batch-create nodes, apply many edits at once). Individual scene_edit tools still work.
